classification_feature_selection.method: ANOVA F-statistic filter; k fixed at 100 before inspecting held-out metrics.

baseline_all_features.selection: No feature selector; all declared inputs retained

selected_top_100.selection: SelectKBest(f_classif, k=100), fit only on the training partition

classification_feature_selection.interpretation_limit: The held-out comparison is one grouped split. The selected model is a sensitivity analysis; K was not tuned on this holdout.

conflicting_label_cleaning_sensitivity.method: Exclude all rows from a full-feature signature group when that exact signature has both target labels.
conflicting_label_cleaning_sensitivity.warning: This is a retrospective, target-informed cleaning sensitivity variant. It is not used for the primary holdout metrics because screening labels across the full file can change the evaluation population.

geometry_iqr_review.decision: Retain these rows. IQR fences are review flags; the audit found finite positive geometry and the raw file does not establish that extreme formats are corrupt.
